name: io.github.xiaobinger/curlgen-mcp
title: cURL Generator MCP
description: HTTP requests, signed code generation, GateShell/SSH execution and file transfer.

environmentVariables.name: CURLGEN_CONFIG_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Config directory. Defaults to ~/.cURL (the desktop app's directory).

environmentVariables.name: CURLGEN_MCP_FILE_ROOTS
environmentVariables.description: Allowed local roots for upload/download, separated by the OS path separator.

environmentVariables.name: CURLGEN_JUMP_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the jump-host password from ssh_config.json.

environmentVariables.name: CURLGEN_ENV
environmentVariables.description: Default signing environment alias when a tool omits environment.

environmentVariables.name: CURLGEN_SIGN_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the signing key from env_configs.json.

environmentVariables.name: CURLGEN_SIGN_ALGO
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the signing algorithm (MD5 or SHA256).

environmentVariables.name: CURLGEN_TARGET_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the target-machine private key path.
